items.definition:
a person who plans or a book/app for planning
I use a daily planner to organize my tasks.

a piece of old or torn cloth
She used a wet rag to wipe the table clean.

the outer surface of a roof
They installed solar panels on the rooftop.

a car with a closed body and a separate boot
He bought a new black sedan.

situation comedy
My favorite sitcom is about a group of friends living in New York.

a small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories
She bought her dress at a small boutique downtown.

a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves
The hotel offered a delicious breakfast buffet.

a part of a stove or lamp that produces a flame or heat
She turned on the gas burner to boil water.

a person or thing that catches, especially in baseball
The baseball catcher wore a protective mask.

a routine task, especially a household one
Doing the dishes is my least favorite chore.

a child's toy doll; a small wheeled platform
The movers used a dolly to transport the heavy furniture.

an annual event at a school or college for former students
The university held its annual homecoming celebration.

a person who translates spoken language orally
An interpreter helped them communicate during the meeting.

a line, spot, or other visible sign on a surface
The animal had distinctive markings on its fur.

a bivalve mollusk
He ordered a plate of fresh oysters.

domestic fowl, such as chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese
We had roast poultry for dinner.

a group of four musicians or singers
The string quartet played beautifully.

mythical horse-like creature with a single horn
Many children believe in the magic of a unicorn.

a plantation of grapevines
They spent the afternoon walking through the vineyard.

a stringed musical instrument
She plays the viola in the school orchestra.

a severe snowstorm with high winds
The town was shut down due to the blizzard.

a small book or pamphlet
The museum provided a free booklet with information about the exhibits.

a pleasant or sweet smell
The fragrance of the roses filled the room.

a woman admired for her courage or outstanding achievements
The heroine of the story saved the day.

a soft mixture that hardens when dry, used for coating walls or making casts
The doctor put her arm in a plaster cast.

a period of time when work or school is stopped for a break
The children played outside during recess.

a large room used for dancing
The wedding reception was held in the grand ballroom.

a spiral or coiled shape
She has beautiful natural curls in her hair.

a small, pointed missile; a sudden rapid movement
He threw a dart at the board.

a sturdy cotton twill fabric, typically blue
She was wearing a pair of blue denim jeans.

tiny drops of water that form on cool surfaces at night
The grass was wet with morning dew.

a mark left by a foot
We saw a large footprint in the sand.

a dialect of Chinese or a type of orange
She is learning to speak Mandarin.

a tall upright post on a ship or for broadcasting
The ship's mast was broken in the storm.

a long, loose outer garment
She put on her soft bathrobe after her shower.

a type of grain or whiskey made from it
He ordered a sandwich on rye bread.

a person who smokes tobacco
My grandfather was a heavy smoker for many years.

a hollow into which something fits
Plug the lamp into the wall socket.

a backless and armless seat
He sat on a bar stool and ordered a drink.

a long, high sea wave caused by an earthquake or other disturbance
The coastal town was devastated by the powerful tsunami.

a person who takes part in wrestling
The wrestler trained for hours every day.

a section or table of additional matter at the end of a book or document; a small, finger-shaped organ projecting from the large intestine
You can find more details in the appendix at the back of the book.

the part of a theater, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits
The school auditorium can seat over 500 people.

a chemical used to whiten or clean things
She used bleach to remove the stain from the white shirt.

A person who studies or practices chemistry; a pharmacist (British English).
She wants to be a chemist and work in a lab.

The outline of a coast, especially with regard to its shape and appearance.
The coastline of California is very beautiful.

A highly venomous snake of tropical Asia and Africa, with a hood that it expands when excited.
The zookeeper warned us about the dangerous cobra.

The end part of a sleeve or trouser leg, folded or sewn as a band.
He rolled up the cuffs of his shirt.

A large refuse container.
He threw the old furniture into the dumpster.

a common viral infection that attacks the respiratory system
Many people get influenza during the winter months.

a person who conducts an interview
The interviewer asked many challenging questions.

a room or space directly under the roof of a house or other building
They converted the old attic into a spacious loft apartment.

a cloth canopy that fills with air and allows a person or heavy object attached to it to descend slowly when dropped from an aircraft
He packed his parachute carefully before the jump.

the state of being a parent
Parenthood brings both joys and challenges.

the amount of money charged for sending a letter or parcel by post
The postage for this letter is quite high.

the way in which a word is pronounced
Good pronunciation is key to clear communication.

a person who shows people to their seats
The usher led us to our seats in the theater.

a long flat-bottomed boat
The barge transported coal along the river.

a slender, deciduous tree
The forest was full of tall birch trees.

the action of feeding a baby with milk from the breast
Breastfeeding provides many benefits for both mother and baby.

a clasp or fastener
He fastened the buckle on his belt.

a light, narrow boat propelled by paddles
They went for a ride in a canoe on the lake.

an alcoholic drink made from fermented apple juice, or non-alcoholic apple juice
We enjoyed a glass of warm apple cider by the fire.

a baby's bed, typically one that rocks
The baby slept peacefully in her cradle.
